items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn't do any big band dates with him. ... There’s a date that Tad Dameron and Melba Liston were involved with. Was it his date? Really?

ctx.x: I didn't do any big band dates with him. I might have done…
There’s a date that Tad Dameron and Melba Liston were involved with.
